title: Powered by Sustainable Energy.
desc: We run entirely on hydro-electricity and hyper-optimized code to minimize hardware overhead. This makes our website cleaner than 92% of all pages tested, and the dashboard cleaner than 95%.

metaTitle: Green Hosting: A Twitch Bot on Hydro Power | ItsBagelBot
metaDesc: ItsBagelBot runs on hydro-electricity in Canada. Website Carbon rates our website cleaner than 92% of pages tested and the dashboard cleaner than 95%.
howTitle: Less hardware for the same bot.
step1Desc: The bot and your settings live on servers in Canada that run entirely on hydro-electricity.
step2Desc: We tune the bot to handle more chat on less hardware, so fewer machines stay switched on.
step3Desc: Every page is built ahead of time and served from Cloudflare's network, so a visit never wakes a server.
item1Desc: Our homepage produces less carbon per visit than 92% of the pages Website Carbon has tested.
item2Desc: The dashboard login page beats 95% of the pages tested.
item3Desc: The servers that run your bot draw on hydro power.
listNote: Website Carbon retests pages over time, so these figures can move.
faqA1: Website Carbon estimates the carbon one visit to a page produces, from how much data it sends and how its host is powered, then ranks it against every page it has tested.
faqQ2: Can I check the results myself?
faqA2: Yes. Both reports are public on Website Carbon and linked at the bottom of this page.
faqQ3: Does the bot do less to save energy?
faqA3: The bot does the same work for your chat. The savings come from running it on clean power with less hardware.
